_comment: Reviewed licence resolutions for scripts/check-builder-sbom.mjs, for components of the builder image whose licence the SBOM
scanner (syft, CycloneDX, Go module licences fetched from the module proxy) cannot read or reads from a NON-compiled file.
Each entry names the exact module version and why the resolution is right. A resolution can only say what the licence IS;
it can never waive a forbidden licence (GPL, LGPL, AGPL, MPL, BSL/BUSL, SSPL, CC-BY-SA, ...): those always fail.

overrides.name: github.com/Data-Masterclass/sovereign-agentic-os/images/base/builder/zot-users
overrides.reason: our own module (images/base/builder/zot-users), SPDX header in every file

overrides.name: github.com/Data-Masterclass/sovereign-agentic-os/images/base/builder/require-userns
overrides.reason: our own module (images/base/builder/require-userns), SPDX header in every file

overrides.name: github.com/moby/buildkit
overrides.reason: main module of buildkitd/buildctl, built from the pinned tag; LICENSE is Apache-2.0

overrides.name: github.com/opencontainers/runc
overrides.reason: main module of runc, built from the pinned tag; LICENSE is Apache-2.0

overrides.name: github.com/rootless-containers/rootlesskit/v3
overrides.reason: main module of rootlesskit, built from the pinned tag; LICENSE is Apache-2.0

overrides.name: github.com/google/go-containerregistry
overrides.reason: main module of crane, built from the pinned tag; LICENSE is Apache-2.0

overrides.name: github.com/opencontainers/go-digest
overrides.reason: code is Apache-2.0 (LICENSE); LICENSE.docs (CC-BY-SA-4.0) covers the documentation only, which is not compiled into any binary

overrides.name: github.com/spdx/tools-golang
overrides.reason: LICENSE.code is Apache-2.0 / LICENSE.docs CC-BY-4.0 (README); the GPL-2.0-only match is a licence TEXT shipped as test data in the module zip, not code
